# Tabs

<!-- START TOKEN(Autogenerated block API docs) -->
**Name:** `core/tabs`
**Category:** [design](/block-editor/reference-guides/core-blocks/core-blocks-design/)
**API Version:** [3](/block-editor/reference-guides/block-api/block-api-versions/)
**Block Type:** [Hybrid](/block-editor/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering/) (static save + server enhancements)

> Display content in a tabbed interface to help users navigate detailed content with ease.

**[Allowed](/block-editor/reference-guides/block-api/block-metadata/#allowed-blocks) inner blocks:**

## Context

_Defined via the [`usesContext` and `providesContext`](/block-editor/reference-guides/block-api/block-context/) properties in block.json._

**Uses context:**

- `core/tabs-list`
- `core/tabs-id`

**Provides context:**

- `core/tabs-activeTabIndex` → attribute `activeTabIndex`
- `core/tabs-editorActiveTabIndex` → attribute `editorActiveTabIndex`

## Block Markup

This is a [**hybrid block**](/block-editor/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering/). It saves static markup that the server may enhance during rendering.

```html
<!-- wp:tabs {"activeTabIndex":0} -->
<!-- Content... -->
<!-- /wp:tabs -->
```
